#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353LL;

long long mod_add(long long a, long long b) {
    long long s = a + b;
    return s >= MOD ? s - MOD : s;
}

long long mod_mul(long long a, long long b) {
    return (a * b) % MOD;
}

long long mod_pow(long long a, long long e) {
    long long res = 1;
    while (e) {
        if (e & 1) res = mod_mul(res, a);
        a = mod_mul(a, a);
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

vector<long long> fact;
vector<long long> invFact;

void precompute_fact(int n) {
    fact.resize(n+1);
    invFact.resize(n+1);
    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        fact[i] = mod_mul(fact[i-1], i);
    }
    invFact[n] = mod_pow(fact[n], MOD-2);
    for (int i=n; i>=1; i--) {
        invFact[i-1] = mod_mul(invFact[i], i);
    }
}

long long ncr(int n, int r) {
    if (r < 0 || r > n) return 0;
    return mod_mul(fact[n], mod_mul(invFact[r], invFact[n-r]));
}

long long smallInv(int n) {
    return mod_mul(invFact[n], fact[n-1]);
}

long long paritySign(long long k) {
    return (k & 1) == 0 ? 1 : MOD - 1;
}

int main() {
    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    int N = n + m;
    precompute_fact(N);
    
    long long phaseSize = 1;
    long long p = 1;
    for (int i = 0; p != 0; i++) {
        p = mod_mul(p, mod_mul(n - i, smallInv(N - i)));
        phaseSize = mod_add(phaseSize, p);
    }
    
    long long answer = 0;
    for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
        long long term = mod_mul(paritySign(k+1), ncr(n, k));
        term = mod_mul(term, (m + k));
        term = mod_mul(term, smallInv(k));
        term = mod_mul(term, phaseSize);
        answer = mod_add(answer, term);
    }
    
    cout << answer << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
